basic_details.offering_entity: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (CSC) & UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Participating UK Higher Education Institutions with CSC joint-funding agreements
basic_details.major_restrictions: Must align with one of six Commonwealth Development Themes: 1) Science and tech for development, 2) Health systems, 3) Global prosperity, 4) Peace and governance, 5) Resilience and crisis response, 6) Access and inclusion.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~800 scholars and fellows funded globally each year
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: ~25 to 40 awards for Pakistan annually via national nominating agencies
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 12 months for Master's; up to 36 months for PhD

nationality_requirements: Citizen of or refugee in an eligible Commonwealth country (Pakistan is eligible)
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Minimum upper second-class (2:1) first degree (16 years education for Master's); relevant Master's (18 years education) for PhD.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 2:1 honours equivalent; HEC criteria typically require minimum 65% or 3.0/4.0 CGPA.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Course aligned with one of the 6 CSC development themes.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Degree completed by start of UK academic year.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Work experience is not mandatory, but professional experience in development or research is heavily valued.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: CSC does not require an English test directly; applicants must meet the individual English language conditions of their selected UK universities.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates must sign a declaration confirming they could NOT afford to study in the UK without this scholarship.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot have previously studied for 1+ academic years in a high-income country.

tuition_fee.details: Full approved university tuition fees covered under CSC agreement.

admission_application_fee.details: University application fees paid by applicant.

accommodation.details: Provided within the monthly living stipend.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living stipend paid directly by CSC.
monthly_stipend.amount: £1,347 / month outside London; £1,652 / month inside London (~PKR 490,000 to 600,000)

airfare.details: Approved economy class air travel from Pakistan to the UK and return flight upon completion.

visa_fee.details: UK Student Route visa application fee reimbursed.

health_insurance.details: Access to NHS covered; immigration health surcharge handled via CSC exemption.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Study travel grant towards the cost of study-related travel in the UK or overseas.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Fieldwork travel grant for PhD candidates to return to Pakistan for data collection.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Warm clothing allowance (£500–£550) upon initial arrival in the UK.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Applicants may list up to 3 UK university course choices on their CSC application form.
participating_institutions: UK Universities having part-funding agreements with CSC (Cambridge, Oxford, Imperial, Edinburgh, Manchester, Birmingham, Glasgow, Leeds, Sussex, etc.)
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 12 months for Master's; 36 months for PhD
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Undergraduate degree, personal statement, development impact plan, references.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Applicants do not need university admission at initial nomination, but must secure university offers before CSC final confirmation.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Explicitly align your course and proposal with the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and Pakistani National Priorities.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: CSC Online Application System (OAS) & HEC Pakistan Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Dual submission process: Apply on CSC OAS portal AND on HEC Pakistan scholarship portal.
step_by_step_workflow: 2. Apply via HEC Pakistan portal (scholarship.hec.gov.pk) under Commonwealth nominating category.
3. Take HEC HAT test (Higher Education Aptitude Test) organized by ETC Pakistan.
4. Upload Development Impact statements addressing local and national impact.
5. Two reference letters uploaded directly by referees to CSC OAS.
6. Submit both applications before respective deadlines (mid-October for CSC; October for HEC).
7. HEC screens applicants based on HAT scores and academic merit to create national nomination list.
8. Nominated candidates' applications sent to CSC UK for final central selection review.
9. CSC announces final awards in May/June.
10. Finalists secure unconditional university offers, obtain visas, and depart in September.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Dual routing: Nominated via HEC Pakistan to CSC UK; apply separately to UK universities.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees directly via CSC OAS.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Detailed Development Impact Statement in 4 parts: 1) Impact on development within 2 years, 2) Impact in 5-10 years, 3) How impact will be measured, 4) Relevance to national development priorities in Pakistan.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Comprehensive research proposal required for PhD applicants including methodology, ethics, and developmental significance.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Complete employment and education history in CSC OAS format.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: CSC UK does not conduct interviews for general Master's/PhD; selection is 100% paper and dossier evaluation. HEC may conduct interviews for specific nominations.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: HEC HAT test required in Pakistan for national shortlisting.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: £0.00 / PKR 0 to CSC (HEC charges nominal HAT test fee ~PKR 2,000).
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC attestation of degrees required prior to departure.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Dual online portal submission (CSC OAS + HEC Portal).

required_documents_checklist.specification: Scanned copy of valid passport information page
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Required to prove citizenship and residency

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete university transcripts with grading key
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be recognized by HEC Pakistan

required_documents_checklist.specification: Submitted directly by referees on institutional letterhead
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be provided via online portal

required_documents_checklist.specification: Exhaustive 4-part plan linking study to Pakistani socioeconomic growth
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Crucial scoring factor for CSC panel

required_documents_checklist.specification: Valid Higher Education Aptitude Test result
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Mandatory for HEC Pakistan nomination shortlist

important_dates_timeline.shortlist_announcement: HEC nominations announced December; CSC final results announced May/June
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Being nominated by HEC does NOT guarantee the scholarship; CSC UK makes final selections based on global development scoring.

selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 25% (Potential impact on the development of the home country)
selection_process_and_weights.test_scores_weight: Screening filter via HEC HAT in Pakistan
selection_process_and_weights.financial_need_weight: Gatekeeper requirement (declaration of inability to self-fund)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Independent panels of senior UK academic subject specialists appointed by CSC.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Scoring across 3 core criteria: 1) Academic merit, 2) Quality of study plan, 3) Potential development impact on the home country.

competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Solid academic foundation with strong focus on poverty reduction, public health, climate, or sustainable industrialization.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Public sector researchers, university lecturers, civil servants, NGO workers, and environmental scientists.

fake_websites_and_scams: Scam agencies charging 'nomination processing fees' claiming guaranteed HEC quotas. HEC and CSC applications are free/nominal.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: CSC charges NO application fee whatsoever.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: CSC applications must be submitted solely by the candidate.
hidden_costs_breakdown: IELTS/English test fees required by UK universities.
Tuberculosis screening certificate fee (IOM clinics PKR 15,000 to 20,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: An HEC nomination guarantees a scholarship. (Fact: HEC nominates ~2x the quota; CSC UK rejects around 50% of national nominees during the final central review).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some third parties claim work experience is mandatory; official CSC rules do not require work experience for Master's courses.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Maintain satisfactory academic progress as certified by the host institution.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical attendance in the UK.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reports submitted by university supervisors to CSC.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Part-time employment allowed up to 20 hours/week under UK visa rules, subject to academic supervisor approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: MANDATORY Return: Must return to home country upon completion of the award. Ineligible for UK graduate work route visas.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Agreement to return and apply skills to home country development.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Failure to complete degree or failure to return to home country triggers repayment obligation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Changing institutions is not allowed without express prior permission from CSC.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Extensions are rarely granted; PhD funding capped strictly at 36 months.
